note: Canonical section set for dubizzle deliverables. Stable string ids; display numbers are computed at render time from which sections apply. Never hardcode a display number, and never add a lettered id.

summary.title: Summary
summary.validator: names the feature, the problem, the platforms, and what changed since the previous version

prototype.title: Interactive prototype
prototype.validator: every transition resolves to an existing node id; entry screen reachable to all others; every screen has a route back

button-states.title: Button states
button-states.generated_from: component states declared in the design system registry
button-states.validator: every interactive component in use shows default, hover, active, focus, disabled, loading

state-screens.title: State screens
state-screens.generated_from: registry states + qa findings with section_hint state-screens
state-screens.validator: every state in the registry is shown; empty state present regardless of whether the registry declared it

screens-redlines.title: Screens, states and redlines
screens-redlines.validator: every screen carries node ids; every id resolves in the ledger; the redline panel is inlined

rules.title: Rules
rules.validator: each rule is testable — a reader can say whether an implementation satisfies it

motion.title: Interaction and motion
motion.applies_when: the feature supplies motion values measured from live (motion is unmeasured in this design system)
motion.validator: every transition names a duration, an easing and a trigger; reduced-motion behaviour stated

dotlottie.title: dotLottie
dotlottie.applies_when: a lottie asset is referenced (the design system ships none — normally not applicable)
dotlottie.validator: every referenced lottie exists in the asset manifest and is inlined in the bundle

gestures.title: Gestures and behaviours
gestures.applies_when: web-mobile is in scope and gestures are specified
gestures.validator: every gesture names its target node id, its threshold, and what happens on failure

edge-cases.title: Edge cases and error states
edge-cases.validator: covers content extremes, network failure, permission failure, and the empty-vs-error distinction

assets.title: Assets
assets.applies_when: the feature ships icons, images, or animations
assets.validator: every asset has a name, a format, a size, and is inlined in the bundle

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.generated_from: tokens actually consumed by these screens, filtered from the design system
tokens.validator: filtered view only; every token links back to the design system; no token restated that these screens do not use

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.validator: contrast, hit targets, focus order, labels, RTL each addressed or explicitly out of scope

performance.title: Performance budget
performance.applies_when: a runtime budget has been declared for this feature
performance.validator: states what is being budgeted and against what number; a budget with no source is not a budget

tracking.title: Analytics and tracking
tracking.applies_when: a tracking.json is registered for this feature (registry.features[*].tracking)
tracking.generated_from: the feature's tracking.json resolved against design-kit/analytics/event-catalog.json and tenants.json, plus trk.* findings
tracking.validator: every event names its screen, its catalog status and its parameters; every metric names its events; per tenant: currency and whether GA4 ids are known; nothing marked live that was not observed

acceptance.title: Acceptance criteria
acceptance.generated_from: qa checks_run with status pass, plus intake rules
acceptance.validator: every criterion is objectively checkable and references a node id or a check id

platform-notes.title: Platform notes
platform-notes.applies_when: more than one platform is in scope
platform-notes.validator: every declared cross-platform difference has a reason; every undeclared difference is listed as an open question

open-questions.title: Open questions
open-questions.generated_from: qa warnings, waived blockers, open [TBC] tokens, unanswered intake rows
open-questions.validator: each question names who can answer it and what is blocked until they do
